Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_cphy_ppi:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Defines the CPHY PPI Driver, used to process traffic in the TX and RX directions.

For the TX direction it gets Lane Transaction from input TLM port, process it and send it to the bus.

For the RX direction it reassembles Lane Transaction from the bus and then delivers it to the upstream layer via output TLM port.

 uvm_blocking_put_port  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_ppi::rx_lane_xact_out_port

RX Upstream TLM Put Port

Provides a mechanism for sending Lane Transaction that can be recognized by the Upper Layer. The handle to the Lane Transaction TLM put port can be set or obtained through the driver's public member rx_lane_xact_out_port

 uvm_blocking_peek_imp  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_ppi::rx_lane_xact_peek_port

RX Upstream TLM Peek port.

Provides a mechanism for external components to retrieve Lane Transactions from the PPI. These should only be used when the PPI is the top layer in the stack. The handle to this port can be set or obtained through the driver's public member rx_lane_xact_peek_port.
